_help: Cross-platform as-is: ffmpeg's CLI is identical across OSes. Renders a waveform image (showwavespic) for a 2-second window at each of 10 evenly-spaced points across the file's duration — pairs well with Quick Look's audio playback (see PERSONAL.md "Quick Look audio playback"), which auto-plays from the same position when paging through a "time"-paging generator's file. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
